messages:
devon: quick heads-up — vendor sync ended with two sticky items: H200 firmware lagging on a late microcode drop, and an MI300 kernel regression that breaks our quantized path. press embargo window may conflict with marketplace announce if we don't triage.
anya: ok — can you paste the exact firmware release id and the MI300 regression ticket? need to bubble to eng-runtime.
devon: firmware tag is `nv-fw-2026-03-18-rc3` (from vendor), regression is INT-4782 (kernel tiled-matmul fallback). link: https://redwood.internal/INT-4782
karen: cc @nvidia_pm — can you confirm whether the rc3 fixes the H200 hang on svm? vendors said it should, but last QA run failed on one test :(
vidia_pm: looking — rc3 addresses the svm path but there's a driver patch queued that hasn't hit the marketplace image yet. timeline: vendor can push driver by EOD Friday PST if nothing else blocks.
sam: if driver ships Friday, how long to validate on our Dedicated pools and SI images? we need a green signal before canary announce.
anya: rough estimate: smoke + perf run ~24 hours; SI full compatibility matrix another 48–72 depending on queue. so minimum 72 hours for reasonable confidence.
gaudi_partner: on Gaudi side we saw no regression, but our cert harness flagged tail latency for long sequences when cross-request batching is enabled. probably unrelated but worth noting for the joint press narrative.
devon: thanks — so combined: vendor driver by Fri EOD, at least 72h validation -> earliest safe announce Monday next week (assuming no surprises). press embargo currently set for Mon 09:00 PT. that gives us a tight margin.
karen: recommended action: (1) ask vendor to accelerate driver to today if possible, (2) run targeted perf suite for 6 hottest templates, (3) hold marketplace publish until SI green. can we get a volunteer to own steps 1+2?
sam: i'll own perf runs for Dedicated pools and coordinate SI queueing. starting now.
anya: i'll ping vendor PM and the release-bot to request an expedited driver release and to put the marketplace publish on hold until we mark `marketplace-ready`.
release-bot: publish_request: paused for `nv-fw-2026-03-18-rc3` by request of @anya; note added: "hold for kernel regression INT-4782 validation" :pause_button:
nvidia_pm: acked. i'll talk to infra and see if we can ship a hotfix today. will update this thread with a concrete CN.
devon: perfect. please report any slip > 4h so we can push embargo back. also ping legal/comms if we need to update embargo recipients. :thumbsup:
karen: we should also update the marketplace docs with a small note about known perf variance on Gaudi when batching long sequences — not consumer-facing but internal ops need heads-up.
gaudi_partner: will open a short ops note and link it here when done.
sam: starting perf runs now, will post results in ~3h. if we see regressions i'll open INT-xxxx and tag @eng-runtime.
devon: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. looping back in 3h with status.
